chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Arzami from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I prayed behind Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) over a funeral, and he said Takbir five times, raising his hand with each Takbir.
ai.seo_question: How many Takbirs are performed in the funeral prayer and what is the action of the hands?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the prophetic tradition (Sunnah) of the Imam, Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq), performing five Takbirs while raising his hands for each, a practice that underscores the physical reverence in Salat al-Janazah. It serves as a key evidentiary basis in Shia jurisprudence for the number of Takbirs and the specific manner of standing and raising hands during the funeral prayer, distinguishing it from other ritual prayers.
